item.title: Ubuntu 24.04 Kernel Panic After an Update: Fixing a Failed DKMS Build
item.description: After an Ubuntu 24.04 update, a kernel panic prevented my computer from booting. This post documents how I used an older kernel to investigate an incomplete update, identified a failed Realtek 8852au DKMS build, and restored the system without reinstalling Ubuntu or losing personal data. …
